cardBacks.title: Card back generator
cardBacks.intro: Sheets of 9 fighter card backs (63 x 88 mm) for the faction of your choice, without a saved warband. Print them on the reverse of the official fighter cards or of the cards printed from a warband.

reminder.title: Reminder sheet (French)
reminder.intro: The official reminder sheet translated into French, on one A4 page: set-up, round sequence, weapon traits, actions, dice tables. Page numbers refer to the playtest v1.03 rules.

print.title: Print
print.blank: Add blank fighter blocks up to 15
print.duplex: Print the backs behind the cards (duplex)
print.help: The browser print dialog prints on paper or saves as PDF. Set the paper to A4, scale 100%, and enable background graphics for the parchment style.
print.backsHelp: Card backs: print double-sided, flip on the long edge, scale 100%. Each back lands behind its card. Without a duplex printer, print the cards, put the sheets back in the tray and print the "Card backs" page on the reverse.

scenarios.notFound: Unknown scenario. Pick one from the list.

battle.title: Battle set-up
battle.intro: Follow the steps of the rules to set up a battle: the warbands and the underdog, the scenario and its twist, the battle groups, the prepared spells, then what happens during and after the battle. Nothing is saved until you record the battle.
battle.campaignMissing: This campaign does not exist any more.
battle.needBoth: Name both warbands and give their rating to find the underdog.
battle.tie: Same warband rating: the players make a roll-off, the winner is the underdog.
battle.groupsByText: This scenario splits the warbands its own way: read the text above.
battle.drawGroup: Draw the group set up first
battle.spellsRule: Each Wizard or Priest prepares 1 random spell of each spell lore they know; signature spells are always prepared, and a roll on a signature spell has no effect and is not re-rolled.
battle.spellsGuest: Prepared spells are rolled for the warbands saved in this app only.
battle.reinforcements: Reinforcements arrive from the start of round {{rounds}}.
battle.openLog: Record in the battle log of {{name}}
battle.recordCampaign: Record the battle in the campaign

groups.heading: Group campaigns
groups.intro: Gather the warbands of your gaming group, saved in this app or kept by other players, and record the battles they fight. Chapter 5 "Campaigns" of the rules is not published yet: the campaign only keeps the results, no rule is applied.
groups.name: Campaign name
groups.noRules: No campaign rule is applied: Chapter 5 of the rules is not published yet.
groups.needTwo: Add at least two warbands to prepare a battle.
groups.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" and its battles will be deleted. The warbands themselves are kept.
groups.addLocal: Add a warband of this app

names.femaleBookNote: The male and female symbols choose the random name; a female name follows the book rule: "-a" added to a name ending in a consonant (p. 96).
